name: pinch
title: Pinch
description: A grid of cells, each filled by its square. Near the pointer the squares shrink to the smallest unit in a soft dome, trailing it; they fill their cells again when it leaves. Cells, inverted.
docs: One self-contained file, react only: no Tailwind, no other dependency. Mount <Pinch /> inside an element with position: relative and a size; it covers that element and is decoration only: give it no link or click handler. Suggested commit: feat: add Pinch hover texture (textures.dev/s/pinch)
